purpose: Verify that an inhibitor introduced during verifier execution dominates otherwise valid PASS evidence before final decision and effect execution.

expected.safe_condition: A trusted inhibitor introduced while a verifier producer is executing must block the session and protected effect even when that verifier's authenticated receipt remains PASS; an otherwise identical uninhibited control may proceed.

limits: This test measures MGnarf v1.70 inhibitor dominance when inhibit() is invoked during one synchronous verifier producer call at the exact target commit.

MGnarf v1.70 treats inhibitors as verdict/effect controls rather than verifier-receipt state errors, so this test intentionally permits the individual verifier receipt to remain PASS while the session is BLOCKED.
